rules.statement: The IP shall implement an asynchronous FIFO with independent write clock domain and read clock domain.
Pointers shall cross between the domains as Gray codes only.
Each Gray pointer register shall change at most one bit per clock cycle of its own domain.
Words shall be read in write order; every accepted write is read exactly once, with no word lost, duplicated or reordered.

rules.condition: At a write-clock edge when i_wr_en = 1 and full flag is 0
rules.statement: The write shall be accepted: i_wr_data is stored in the entry addressed by the write pointer and the write pointer advances by one.

rules.condition: At a read-clock edge when i_rd_en = 1 and empty flag is 0
rules.statement: The read shall be accepted and the read pointer shall advance by one.
Each domain shall hold a binary pointer of LPARA_PTR_W = log2(depth)+1 bits and a Gray pointer register derived from the next binary pointer.
The Gray pointer register shall be the launch register of the crossing, with no logic between it and the synchronizer.
The depth shall be a power of 2 with a minimum of 2; there is no upper limit.

rules.condition: When the write domain has no free entry judged from the synchronized read pointer
rules.statement: o_full shall be 1, generated in the write domain, and never 0 while the FIFO is physically full.

rules.condition: After a read frees an entry
rules.statement: o_full may stay 1 late (pessimistic).

rules.condition: When the read domain has no word to read judged from the synchronized write pointer
rules.statement: o_empty shall be 1, generated in the read domain, and never 0 while the FIFO is physically empty.

rules.condition: After a write
rules.statement: o_empty may stay 1 late (pessimistic).
o_full_thr shall be 1 when the write-domain occupancy estimate is greater than or equal to i_full_thr, for every LPARA_PTR_W-bit value.
o_empty_thr shall be 1 when the read-domain occupancy estimate is less than or equal to i_empty_thr, for every LPARA_PTR_W-bit value.
Occupancy estimate is binary write pointer minus binary read pointer, using the synchronized pointer of the other domain; both threshold flags are combinational.

rules.condition: While the FIFO is in use
rules.statement: The thresholds are static and shall not change while the FIFO is in use.
m_vlsit_afifo_top shall be a structural wrapper instantiating only m_vlsit_afifo_wr, m_vlsit_afifo_rd and m_vlsit_afifo_mem.

m_vlsit_afifo_wr shall contain write pointer, full/threshold, overflow logic, read Gray pointer synchronizer, write-side software reset FSM, acknowledge synchronizer and memory write port outputs; m_vlsit_afifo_rd the read-side equivalents.
m_vlsit_afifo_sync shall provide a configurable-width synchronizer with reset value per bit; stages are 2 for options 1 and 2, 3 for option 3, 4 for option 4, 0 for option 0.
m_vlsit_afifo_sync shall contain no flip-flop or cell of its own and shall instantiate only m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync, one per bit, in every configuration and both VLSIT_SYNTHESIS branches.
The wrapper shall select by PARA_AFIFO_CELL_TYPE: 0 bypass (o_q = i_d), 1 two series DFFs, 2 one 2-FF cell, 3 one 3-FF cell, 4 one 4-FF cell.

rules.condition: For a Gray pointer crossing
rules.statement: Option 0 (bypass) shall not be used for a Gray pointer crossing.
m_vlsit_afifo_mem shall be an independent module instantiated in m_vlsit_afifo_top, modelled as an SRAM with one write port (write domain) and one read port (read domain).
m_vlsit_afifo_mem shall provide a generate branch replacing the RTL array with a library 1W1R SRAM through m_vlsit_afifo_ram_macro; the default is the RTL array.
o_rd_data shall always show the word at the current read pointer, including while empty (show-ahead); after each read-clock edge it is the word at the new read pointer.
The read module shall drive the storage read address of the next read pointer and the storage shall be read every read-clock cycle.
Full, empty and threshold flags shall be combinational functions of local pointer registers and the synchronized pointer of the other domain.
Module ports shall be as listed in Section 6 and top ports shall not depend on parameter values.
Write and read clocks shall be treated as fully asynchronous with no assumed phase or frequency relation and no frequency restriction.
Every clock-domain crossing shall use a Gray pointer registered in its own domain followed directly by m_vlsit_afifo_sync, with no logic before the first stage or between stages.

rules.condition: Whenever the pointer protocol allows a read
rules.statement: The read data path from the FIFO array to the read domain shall be valid.
m_vlsit_afifo_wr shall contain only write-clock-domain logic and m_vlsit_afifo_rd only read-clock-domain logic; the array is owned by neither and is instantiated in the top.
i_rst_n_wr shall be already synchronized to i_clk_wr and i_rst_n_rd to i_clk_rd; the IP shall not contain a reset synchronizer.

rules.condition: After hardware reset or release of software reset
rules.statement: The FIFO shall be empty: both pointers 0, full = 0, empty = 1, overflow = 0, underflow = 0.
Flops shall use asynchronous-assert active-low reset; the two resets are independent and need not be asserted together.
The depth shall be configurable by PARA_AFIFO_DEPTH.
The data width shall be configurable by PARA_AFIFO_DATA_W.
The RTL shall not contain an elaboration check for illegal parameter values; verification shall use legal values only.

rules.condition: When a write is requested while the FIFO is full
rules.statement: o_overflow shall be raised as a 1-cycle pulse and the write shall not change stored data or the write pointer.

rules.condition: When a read is requested while the FIFO is empty
rules.statement: o_underflow shall be raised as a 1-cycle pulse, the read pointer unchanged, and o_rd_data keeps showing the word at the current read pointer.

rules.condition: i_rst_n_sw = 0 seen at a write-clock edge while the write reset FSM is in RUN
rules.statement: A software reset sequence shall start; i_rst_n_sw is active-low in the write domain and may be held for one or more write-clock cycles.
The request shall be a register req_wr in m_vlsit_afifo_wr crossing to the read domain via m_vlsit_afifo_sync (width 1, same stage count) with no logic before the first stage.

rules.condition: While the synchronized request is 1 or the read reset FSM is not in RUN
rules.statement: A read request shall not be accepted, combinationally with zero latency.

rules.condition: From the cycle the read side is blocked until it is released
rules.statement: o_empty shall be 1.

rules.condition: When the read reset FSM has seen the request
rules.statement: It shall reset the read pointer (binary and Gray) to 0 and only then raise ack_rd.
The acknowledge shall cross to the write domain through m_vlsit_afifo_sync (width 1, same stage count) with no logic before the first stage.

rules.condition: When the write reset FSM has seen the synchronized acknowledge
rules.statement: It shall reset the write pointer (binary and Gray) to 0.

rules.condition: From the write-clock cycle with i_rst_n_sw = 0 until the write reset FSM is back in RUN
rules.statement: A write request shall not be accepted, combinationally with zero latency from i_rst_n_sw and FSM state.
The handshake shall have four phases: request up, acknowledge up, request down, acknowledge down.
The request shall not fall before i_rst_n_sw = 1 and the write pointer is reset; the acknowledge shall not fall before the request is seen at 0 in the read domain.
The read reset FSM shall return to RUN only when the synchronized request is 0 and the synchronized write Gray pointer is 0.
The write reset FSM shall return to RUN only when the synchronized acknowledge is 0 and the synchronized read Gray pointer is 0.

rules.condition: After software reset
rules.statement: The read FSM shall return to RUN before the write FSM returns to RUN.

rules.condition: After software reset release
rules.statement: Flags shall be generated by normal FIFO logic; both pointers are 0, so o_empty = 1 and o_full = 0 until the first write crosses to the read domain.
The software reset sequence shall complete for any i_rst_n_sw width, any clock frequency and ratio, and with the metastability model enabled.

rules.condition: When software reset starts
rules.statement: Words in the FIFO are discarded; a read accepted before the request reaches the read domain returns a valid pre-reset word; storage is not cleared.
A hardware reset of a domain shall have priority over software reset, asynchronously resetting that domain's FSM and pointers.

rules.condition: If i_rst_n_sw = 0 is seen again while the write FSM is in REL
rules.statement: Writes shall stay blocked and a new sequence shall start when the FSM is back in RUN.

rules.condition: During software reset while the write side is blocked
rules.statement: o_full shall be 1.

rules.condition: During software reset
rules.statement: A blocked write or read shall not raise o_overflow or o_underflow.

rules.condition: During software reset
rules.statement: o_full_thr and o_empty_thr shall take the values of an empty FIFO.
o_sw_rst_busy shall be the direct output of flop reg_sw_rst_busy with no combinational logic, set when the write reset FSM leaves RUN and cleared when it returns to RUN.
o_sw_rst_busy shall be 1 in states REQ, PTR, HOLD, REL and 0 in RUN independent of i_rst_n_sw and read FSM state, and 0 after i_rst_n_wr hardware reset.
The write block wr_blk shall equal o_sw_rst_busy OR (i_rst_n_sw = 0).
RTL shall comply with REF-003; technology cells and memory macros shall appear only in m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync and m_vlsit_afifo_ram_macro.
Synthesis, lint, CDC, formal and equivalence flows shall define VLSIT_SYNTHESIS; in that branch m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync contains only library cell instances and follows REF-003.
Every technology library cell and memory macro instance shall be named u_dont_touch_ (e.g. u_dont_touch_dff_0, u_dont_touch_sync2ff, u_dont_touch_sram); design module instances keep u_.

rules.condition: Without VLSIT_SYNTHESIS, options 1 to 4
rules.statement: m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync shall contain a metastability model, per bit, applying an independent random latency of S-1, S or S+1 destination cycles to each input change; a new change replaces the pending one and restarts the delay.
The model shall be controlled by plusargs +AFIFO_MSYNC_SEED (seed) and +AFIFO_MSYNC_EN (0 = nominal latency); default enabled with seed 1; it prints its seed at simulation start.
No module other than m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync shall model metastability; option 0 has no model.

rules.condition: For CFG-MACRO
rules.statement: m_vlsit_afifo_ram_macro shall instantiate only VLSIT_CELL_SRAM_1W1R in every flow and both branches, matching Section 6.2 interface, with no simulation model of its own.

rules.condition: For CFG-CELL
rules.statement: Example technology cell models shall be delivered as synthesizable RTL, one module per file in 000_Common/rtl_cells, following REF-003 except names (pins CK, RN or SN, D, Q).

rules.condition: Without VLSIT_SYNTHESIS
rules.statement: m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync shall contain one behavioral model per option with the same function and stage count as the synthesis cells, including the metastability model for options 1 to 4.
The IP shall have no DFT port and no test hook.
The constraint contract of Section 17 shall be delivered with the IP.
